mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kcb_close_daily WHERE trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY trade_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kcb_close_daily (trade_date, close_arithmetic, close_float_weighted, close_total_weighted, stock_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{item.tradeDate}, #{item.closeArithmetic}, #{item.closeFloatWeighted}, #{item.closeTotalWeighted}, #{item.stockCount}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE close_arithmetic = VALUES(close_arithmetic), close_float_weighted = VALUES(close_float_weighted), close_total_weighted = VALUES(close_total_weighted), stock_count = VALUES(stock_count), updated_at = NOW()
